newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech state budget CZK 6.7 bln deficit-end-Feb.
newsitem.headline: Czech state budget CZK 6.7 bln deficit-end-Feb.

text.p: The Czech 1997 state budget showed a 6.7 billion crown ($228.6 million) deficit at the end of February, the Finance Ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said revenues totalled 70.1 billion crowns, while expenditures were 76.8 billion crowns.
CZECH STATE BUDGET FEB 97 JAN 97 FY 96
Note: The budget showed a surplus of 3.2 billion crowns at the end of February 1996.
A ministry official said the swing to a deficit from January's surplus was due to lower-than-estimated tax revenues and a slower-than-expected economy. The official did not elaborate.
